exempt.container: Blob container, a child object of the export store; the demo show it
exempt.exportBlob: Blob name of the fictional nightly export, not an Azure resource
exempt.easmWorkspace: CAF lists no abbreviation for a Defender EASM workspace, and the name takes letters and digits only, so it reads easm + workload + ###
exempt.discoveryGroup: EASM data-plane object (discovery group), not an Azure resource; the demo shows it

tags.lifecycle: retain through Lesson 14; idle between runs (Reset-L12Lab.ps1)

storageOverride.note: Resource-level Defender for Storage settings for the export store: override the subscription, keep malware scanning with a small monthly cap, keep sensitive data threat detection.

defenderWindow.note: Set-L12DefenderWindow.ps1 opens these subscription plans at least 24 hours before the demo and closes them after the last lesson that needs them. On a new subscription both read Free with a 30-day trial unused on 2026-11-05, so the first Open starts each trial (Learn: Azure gives a 30-day trial each time a plan is first activated on a subscription). Malware scanning isn't covered by the trial and bills per GB scanned from day one.

roles.note: your data role on the export store. Storage Blob Data Owner is the least-privileged built-in role that can read blob index tags, where Defender for Storage writes the malware scan verdict (demo 12.2). Contributor was the first choice and is removed by Deploy-L12Lab.ps1 if present.

costPosture.note: you, 2026-09-28: keep idle cost at or near zero until you need it. Idle baseline: both stores exist, the export store has Defender for Storage excluded at the resource level, and the EASM workspace holds a small discovery (your one domain). Deploy-L12Lab.ps1 -Stage creates the container and export before the demo; Reset-L12Lab.ps1 returns to the idle baseline.

costEstimateUsd.retained: Two Standard_LRS storage accounts holding a few KB bill fractions of a cent a month. Defender CSPM and Defender for Storage are inside their 30-day trials on this subscription.
costEstimateUsd.perRun: Malware scanning bills per GB scanned (a few KB per run). EASM bills per Approved asset per day if no trial applies; four or five assets cost cents a day.
costEstimateUsd.notes: Retail estimate before credits and tax. Missing billing rows don't prove zero cost.

posture.note: Assessment keys are Microsoft's fixed recommendation IDs, read live on 2026-09-28. The governance assignment key is the lab's own fixed name so Reset-L12Lab.ps1 can find and remove it. No VM is deployed in this lab, so the secret-finding keys are null and the Secrets mode says so.
posture.sharedKeyDisplayName: Storage accounts should prevent shared key access
